<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>A sequence detector for detecting the sequence '1001'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Asynchronous active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit binary input signal for data stream.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal indicating if the sequence has been detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State representing idle condition.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State representing the first bit of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State representing the second bit of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State representing the third bit of the sequence.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State representing the fourth bit of the sequence.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[3:0]">Register to hold current state.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[3:0]">Register to hold next state.</reg>
        
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
            if (!reset_n) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                S1: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S2: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S3: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                S4: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end
        
        // Output logic
        assign sequence_detected = (current_state == S4);
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // FSM implementation
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clock or negative edge of reset
        // Update current state register
        // Combinational logic block for determining next state
        // Default case to handle unexpected states
    </implementation>
</module>
